-- Check: store sales for P1-P3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS store_receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS store_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13

-- Check: web sales and orders for P1-P3 (by dispatch date)
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
           status
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wd.web_order_id) AS web_orders,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch wd ON wd.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = wd.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13

-- Final: ATV for whole company including web, P1-P3 FY2026/27
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
store_data AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
           SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
web_data AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wd.web_order_id) AS orders,
           SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch wd ON wd.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = wd.dispatch_date
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
)
SELECT 
    'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
    'P01-P03' AS periods,
    sd.net_sales + wd.net_sales AS total_net_sales,
    sd.receipts + wd.orders AS total_transactions,
    ROUND((sd.net_sales + wd.net_sales) / (sd.receipts + wd.orders), 2) AS atv
FROM store_data sd
CROSS JOIN web_data wd
